---
title: "Join us"
date-modified: 2026-10-02
---

We welcome LCA practitioners, researchers, students, and industry members from any sector. You do not need AI expertise to contribute, and you do not need to commit to a fixed amount of time.

## Ways to take part

1. **Join a meeting.** The full working group meets online every two weeks. Ask any project lead or use the contact form below, and we will send you the invitation.
2. **Join a project.** Each project page lists what it needs help with right now:
    - [Tiers of LCA](projects/tiers.qmd)
    - [AI for LCA of emerging technologies](projects/ai-for-lca.qmd)
    - [Design flexibility across TRL](projects/design-flexibility.qmd)
3. **Contribute without joining.** Send us a paper for the [literature inventory](guidance/literature.qmd), an AI failure you have seen for the [red flags list](guidance/red-flags.qmd), or a correction to anything on this site.

## What happens after you reach out

A member of the group will reply, add you to the meeting invitation, and point you to the project that fits your interests.
